device.title: This machine

line.setup: {done}/{total} steps done · finish them to control this machine from your phone and sync with other machines
line.off: Remote Control is off — phones and other machines can't see this one.
line.idConflict: Refused by the relay — Devdy retries in a few minutes.
line.phone: A phone is controlling this machine.
line.ready: Connected to {host} · no phone in control

device.disconnectHint: The phone has to sign in again with the master password.

errors.relay_unreachable: Can't reach the relay. Check the network and the relay URL — Devdy keeps retrying.
errors.relay_bad_url: The relay URL doesn't point to a Devdy relay (wrong address or path). Check the URL, e.g. wss://relay.example.com/ws.
errors.relay_auth_failed: The relay rejected this machine's auth token. Enter the relay's host token again.
errors.relay_unsupported: The relay is too old for this Devdy. Update the relay server.
errors.relay_rate_limited: The relay is throttling this machine. Devdy retries shortly.
errors.device_id_conflict: Another running Devdy uses this machine's device ID, so the relay refused this one.
errors.relay_not_configured: No relay URL is set. Enter it under Connection.
errors.token_missing: The relay auth token is missing from the Keychain. Enter it again.
errors.agent_stopped: Remote Control stopped. Retry, or check the relay settings.
errors.unknown: Not connected to the relay yet.

conflict.alias: The name "{name}" is used by another machine on this relay. Sync can't tell the two apart, and both compete for the web controller sign-in. Pick another name.
conflict.deviceId: Another running Devdy has the same device ID as this machine — usually because the Devdy data (~/.devdy) was copied or the disk was cloned. The relay refuses this machine and Devdy retries in a few minutes. Use a new device ID to connect now.
conflict.newIdDone: New device ID in use — reconnecting
conflict.confirmMessage:
This machine gets a new device ID and reconnects to the relay (a few seconds).
Paired phones and push notifications keep working.
Other machines see this one as a new device in their sync list.

hints.relay: Your self-hosted relay: its URL and host auth token.
hints.name: How phones and other machines find this one.
hints.password: Phones sign in to this machine with it; other machines use it to sync from this one.
hints.enable: This machine connects to the relay and shows up for phones and other machines.

relay.urlInvalid: The URL must start with wss:// (or ws://).
relay.tokenKeep: Leave blank to keep the current token
relay.tokenRequired: Enter the relay's host auth token.
relay.tokenHint: Kept in the OS Keychain, never written to disk in plain text.

name.label: Device name
name.hint: Lowercase letters, digits and '-' (up to 32). Type it on the phone with the master password to sign in to this machine.
name.invalid: Use only lowercase letters, digits and '-' (up to 32).

password.label: Master password
password.hint: Kept in the Keychain. Changing or clearing it signs out every phone.
password.clearMessage: Phones can no longer sign in, and other machines can't sync from this one until you set a new one.

phone.title: Phone
phone.controlling: A phone is controlling this machine.
phone.none: No phone is controlling this machine. Pair one to scan a QR code.
phone.off: Remote Control is off: phones can't connect, and notifications are only sent while it is on.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.clearMessage:
Permanently delete every Remote Control activity entry?
This cannot be undone.
activity.alreadyEmpty: The activity log is already empty

actions.login: Sign in with the master password
actions.authenticate: Sign in with a pairing link

session.title: Pair a phone
session.needsPasswordDesc: Phones sign in to {name} with the master password. Set it once; it is used for every pairing and for sync.
session.step1: Scan the code with the phone camera, or copy the link and open it on the phone.
session.step2: Enter the device name {name} and the master password.
session.expiresIn: Code expires in {time} · a new one is made when it does
session.cannotDeriveController: Couldn't work out the controller address from the relay URL. Copy the fields below and paste them into the controller.
session.enterMasterToFinish: Enter the master password on the phone to finish.
session.phoneControlling: The phone is paired and can drive every run. Closing this window does not disconnect it.
session.disabledDesc: Turn it on to create a link for the phone.
session.disabledNoRelay: Set up the relay in Settings → Devices first, then turn Remote Control on.

push.title: Push notifications
push.intro: Paired phones that turned on notifications (bell in the phone's Inbox) are notified while Remote Control is on and the phone is not open. Run notifications carry counts only; Focus reminders carry the todo's text, end-to-end encrypted to the phone.

kindHints.pending: A permission prompt, question or credential approval is waiting.
kindHints.done: A run finished, or a session finished its turn and waits for you.
kindHints.failed: A run ended with an error.
kindHints.focus: The desktop's Focus reminders (start by, due soon, overdue, remind me, morning summary), with the todo's text. Sent even while the phone is open.

push.noDevices: No device yet. On the phone, open the Inbox and tap the bell.

toast.gone: The push service no longer knows this device — it was removed.

push.removeMessage: {label} stops receiving notifications. It can subscribe again from the phone.
